ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with 5% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and stochastic speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black field across both lobes; high-contrast white circular clusters mapped to the distal lateral tips; dispersed micro-scale white pixel clusters (speckling) scattered non-uniformly across the entire surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute internal angle; approximately 40-50 pixels in vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the posterior boundary; irregular jagged peaks and valleys with varying amplitudes; higher concentration of sharp protrusions on the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following a mathematical arc from the median notch to the distal tips; symmetrical upwards and outwards projection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity circular pixel structures (diameter 5-15 pixels) located on the far left and far right lateral edges, consistent with parasitic colonization artifacts.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear pixel disruptions; distinct diagonal white rake marks on the left lobe; smaller unaligned scratches on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear scars (rake marks) on the left lobe; significant irregular surface texture and encrustation on the lateral margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt and pepper' speckling pattern across the dark pigmentation of both fluke lobes.
